comment: Spec 015 FR-1500: which end-to-end checks a pull request's changed files select. A path under 'shared' selects every capability. A capability with no checks on a runner is reported as skipped with its reason (FR-1506) and runs in the weekly test Mac run. relay/internal/evals tests that every source file matches a path here.

logins.skip: needs the Owner's Passwords, which GitHub's Mac runner doesn't have

notes.skip: needs Automation permission for Notes, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant

messages.skip: needs Messages and Full Disk Access, which GitHub's Mac runner doesn't have

mail.skip: needs an Apple Mail account and Full Disk Access, which GitHub's Mac runner doesn't have

whatsapp.skip: needs WhatsApp signed in, which no test machine has

computer.skip: needs Accessibility and Screen Recording, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant

calendar.skip: needs Calendar access, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant

reminders.skip: needs Reminders access, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant

contacts.skip: needs Contacts access, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant

location.skip: needs Location Services, which GitHub's Mac runner can't grant
